description: This file defines the interface for the Starboard System module, including system properties, paths, capabilities, error handling, and system control functions.

methods.name: SbSystemRaisePlatformError
methods.description: Notify the platform of a system error, providing a callback for user response.

methods.name: SbSystemBreakIntoDebugger
methods.description: Break into debugger if attached, otherwise abort.

methods.name: SbSystemIsDebuggerAttached
methods.description: Check if a debugger is attached.

methods.name: SbSystemGetNumberOfProcessors
methods.description: Get the number of processor cores available.

methods.name: SbSystemGetTotalCPUMemory
methods.description: Get total CPU memory available to the application.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedCPUMemory
methods.description: Get total CPU memory used by the application.

methods.name: SbSystemGetTotalGPUMemory
methods.description: Get total GPU memory available for use.

methods.name: SbSystemGetUsedGPUMemory
methods.description: Get current GPU memory used by the application.

methods.name: SbSystemGetPath
methods.description: Retrieve system path for a given path ID.

methods.name: SbSystemGetProperty
methods.description: Retrieve system property value for a given property ID.

methods.name: SbSystemHasCapability
methods.description: Check if the system has a specific runtime capability.

methods.name: SbSystemGetLocaleId
methods.description: Get the current POSIX-style locale ID.

methods.name: SbSystemGetRandomUInt64
methods.description: Get 64 bits of cryptographically secure random data.

methods.name: SbSystemGetRandomData
methods.description: Fill buffer with cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: SbSystemGetLastError
methods.description: Get last platform-specific error code.

methods.name: SbSystemClearLastError
methods.description: Clear last error code.

methods.name: SbSystemGetErrorString
methods.description: Generate human-readable string for an error code.

methods.name: SbSystemGetStack
methods.description: Capture current execution stack addresses.

methods.name: SbSystemSymbolize
methods.description: Lookup symbol for an instruction address.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestBlur
methods.description: Request application to move to blurred (unfocused) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestFocus
methods.description: Request application to move to focused state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestConceal
methods.description: Request application to move to concealed (minimized) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestReveal
methods.description: Request application to move to revealed (focused) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestFreeze
methods.description: Request application to move to frozen (suspended) state.

methods.name: SbSystemRequestStop
methods.description: Request graceful termination of the application.

methods.name: SbSystemHideSplashScreen
methods.description: Hide the system splash screen.

methods.name: SbSystemSupportsResume
methods.description: Check if resume after suspend is supported.

methods.name: SbSystemGetExtension
methods.description: Retrieve extension interface by name.

methods.name: SbSystemSignWithCertificationSecretKey
methods.description: Generate HMAC-SHA256 digest with certification secret.
